basic_info_description: Bernal Bauhaus 19 Elsie is a luxurious, three-bedroom-all on one level, two and a half-bath contemporary-style single family home with one-car parking located on Bernal Heights? coveted northwest slope. This home, elegantly remodeled with designer finishes and fixtures, will wow you with its perfect location, views, attention to detail, and beautiful-yet-practical amenities.The home opens onto a living room with Merbau hardwood floors, soaring ceilings, a gracious bay window, and a lovely high efficiency gas fireplace. The architecturally distinctive and modernist curved ceilings with radius corners in the living room are details that contribute to 19 Elsie's tasteful, modern feel. The living room opens up to the dining room and a beautifully appointed designer kitchen with custom cabinets, a Ceasarstone waterfall edge countertop and built-in Miele appliances. The refrigerator/freezer features built-in wifi, which allows remote connectivity to the Miele service center. The pre-programmable convection oven includes a rotisserie. The open-plan dining room provides direct access to a hardscaped patio and multi-level garden, making it perfect for entertaining. Also on the first floor, you?ll find a laundry room, a pantry, and a half bathroom. The upper level, fully remodeled in 2014, with Acacia hardwood floors throughout, is reached through glass doors and a dramatic stairway with stainless steel banisters that gleam from the light of a skylight. The separated master suite is a delight for devotees of clean design. It features a cozy Regency gas fireplace, a wall-length closet with custom doors and cabinetry, and bay windows with fantastic views stretching from Twin Peaks to the Marin headlands, and the Golden Gate bridge to downtown San Francisco. Entered through a glass barn door sandblasted for privacy the master bath is a spa-like sanctuary. This tranquil space is finished with modern Italian designer tile, has eco-friendly NuHeat radiant heated floors with a timer, two skylights, a deep, a Blu composite stone soaking tub, a separate shower, and a large double Keuco vanity with dual faucets over a gorgeous continuous basin. The Graff fixtures include a thermostatic shower valve. The Keuco vanity makes organization simple. The spacious, second full bathroom has a venting skylight, eco-friendly NuHeat radiant heated floors with a timer, and a single piece sink and vanity, along with Keuco cabinets. The second and third bedrooms both overlook the freshly planted gardens and hardscaped patio, and feature large closets with custom built-in shelves. A spacious walk-in closet off the upstairs hallway provides additional storage space. 19 Elsie is as practical as it is beautiful. The floorplan is ideal with three bedrooms on the same level, and the stylish, tasteful updates mean this home is eco-friendly and move-in ready. Because of the fantastic northwest Bernal Heights location, you're close to the Mission District, several parks, and an ideal Silicon Valley or downtown commute.
